_comment: Smithing rework (Nate, 9 Oct; ~/claude-nate-release/specs/smithing-rework-1009.md): the Blacksmith's 7 craft tiers and the families each one opens, read by smithing.js and manuals.js. id is the family key of loot-materials.json (an item's family comes from there). A family above T1 needs its technique (a manual, private.dboManuals); free: none needed (the tier gate only); technique: <id> = worked with that family's technique; factionExempt: its faction gear (faction-gear.json) is left to the faction rule. book: 'staff' = never shop or loot (given in roleplay); 'apprentice' = no book, learned only by apprenticeship (supervisorRace). raceFree: race editor ids (prefix) whose smiths know it without a book (Bonemold and Chitin for the Dunmer, Nate 11 Oct). noLoot: never in a chest, whatever a drop rule lists (found only by reading; dragon materials only from dragons, Nate 30 Sep). held: closely held (Nate, 11 Oct): never taught by apprenticeship nor copied by a Scholar, so each smith who works it found or bought the book. Most techniques are found by reading (config smithing.discovery). where: the learnHint shown in the F3 Blacksmith tab. bookId: the family's BOOK record (the PC's DBO_Schematics_<family> in DragonBreak Online Edits, 9 Oct); config smithing.books { <id>: '<hex>:<plugin>' } overrides it.py classifies them.
